note: Apply the current linux-port.patch to the staged port and rebuild dlss5vk. This must run and exit 0 before r2026-10-27-g: g measures with the binary this produces. The check that matters is the script's final line - `build/dlss5vk stamp` - which names the port base and the patch sha it carries. A build that exits 0 but stamps the previous patch is the failure this guards: the apply is idempotent, so a run that only applied and never rebuilt looks fine and measures the old binary. Quote the stamp line. If the stamp names a patch other than the one in the repo, stop and report that rather than proceeding to read g.
